items.text:
Picked it back up and started a new save, only to be reminded of the reason I abandoned the last one:
The meat, the damned meat.

I docked with a single derelict that contained it, lamented triggering the event knowingly, and took what I could before leaving. It was too late, though, as the meat had spread through space into my ship's cell. It was in the far corner where I couldn't see it, and by the time I did it was far too late. Half of my hull had become a giant meatball, and after docking at a station for my usual offloading and refueling it struck. Spread right into K-LEG and wouldn't stop.

By the end of it, not only had I noticed my ship's infestation far too late, I was also too late to stop it from infesting the only station I could access at that point in time; it doesn't help that you'll get arrested for fighting the meat in front of people, since this game doesn't register human interaction with much nuance. All of this because the meat had technically entered my ship's cell, meaning it was tainted even if it hadn't touched my ship yet.
It was spreading faster than my single character could possibly claw through it with his crowbar and busted laser welder, so I saw the only fitting end to be a direct impact with Ganymed at 2100 m/s. At least I got a cinematic ending out of this slog.

The takeaway here is that the game just ain't ready. I love Ostranauts to death and I love what Blue Bottle Games are doing with it, but the meat is one of several features that just feels ham-fisted in for the sake of the setting with little regard for how it actually affects gameplay in the long run; it's avoidable, but only if you're lucky enough to notice when it starts or knowledgeable enough to avoid triggering it entirely, both of which are things new players won't be able to do.
It's a shame.
items.text_zh:
我重新捡起它，开了一个新存档，结果又被提醒了我放弃上一个存档的原因：
肉，该死的肉。

我停靠在一艘含有它的废弃飞船上，明知会触发事件还是 lamented 地触发了，然后能拿什么就拿什么，离开了。但已经太晚了，因为肉已经穿过太空蔓延到了我飞船的舱室里。它就在我看不到的远角，等我看到时已经太晚了。我的一半船体已经变成了一个巨大的肉球，而在停靠到一个空间站进行我惯常的卸货和加油后，它发作了。直接蔓延进了K-LEG，停不下来。

到最后，我不仅太晚才注意到飞船的感染，也太晚才阻止它感染我当时唯一能进入的空间站；更糟的是，在人们面前与肉搏斗会被逮捕，因为这款游戏对人类互动的处理缺乏细微差别。所有这一切都是因为肉在技术上已经进入了我的飞船舱室，意味着即使它还没碰到我的飞船，飞船也已经被污染了。
它蔓延的速度比我单个角色用撬棍和坏掉的激光焊枪能劈开的速度快得多，所以我看到了唯一合适的结局：以2100米/秒的速度直接撞向Ganymed。至少我从这场苦差事中得到了一个电影般的结局。

这里的结论是，这款游戏还没准备好。我热爱Ostranauts至极，也热爱Blue Bottle Games对它所做的，但肉是几个感觉像是为了设定而强行塞入的功能之一，几乎不考虑它长期对玩法的影响；它是可以避免的，但只有你足够幸运在它开始时注意到，或者足够了解以完全避免触发它，而这两点新玩家都做不到。
真遗憾。
